world.title: 猜错起点，答案会跳到另一边
world.posterTitle: 每个像素都在猜同一个方程的答案
world.posterHook: 用牛顿法从每个像素出发解 z³−1=0：颜色表示落到哪个解，白线是修正路径。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 牛顿迭代 · 本地构建
world.question: 同一个方程，为什么换个起点答案就变了？
world.hook: 每个像素是一次猜测的起点。青、黄、紫三种颜色 = 三个解的地盘；拖动白点，看修正路径如何扑向某个解。
world.payoff: 多数起点很快落到某个解；颜色交界处起点只差一丝就可能换边——边界是永不平滑的分形。

en.title: Guess from the wrong start, and the answer jumps to another side
en.posterTitle: Every pixel is guessing the answer to the same equation
en.posterHook: Solve z³−1=0 from every pixel with Newton’s method: color shows which root you land on; the white line is the path of corrections.
en.question: Why does the same equation give different answers from different starting points?
en.hook: Each pixel is a starting guess. Cyan, yellow, and purple are the three roots’ territories—drag the white point and watch the correction path rush toward one of them.
en.payoff: Most starts quickly land on a root; near the color boundaries, a tiny nudge can switch sides—the edge is a never-smoothing fractal.
